text:
Noah H: quick QA/design sync re: routing policies preview. i'm worried users won't connect the preview event to the rule that ran when multiple rules match. proposed: spotlight the single winner in the preview (gold outline) + show a condensed "conflict summary" panel that lists shadowed rules with reason. Priya S: love the summary panel idea. can we surface the condition fragments in plain english there? ex: 'Path startsWith /api -> Rule A' so PMs see why. also add a copy button for reproducible examples. Liam C: keyboard accessibility: summary items must be focusable and pressing enter should jump/highlight the corresponding rule in the list. also provide an inline "filter to conflicts" toggle so you can view only shadowed rules. Olga P: copy options for the panel header: - 'Conflict summary' - 'Rules affected by ordering' - 'Shadowed rules' My vote: 'Conflict summary' (neutral + actionable). Noah H: panel actions: - 'Jump to rule' (focus + center in list) - 'Auto-resolve by moving winner up' (applies best-effort) - 'Open resolution suggestions' (give copy/edit suggestions). Priya S: microcopy for auto-resolve confirmation: "Move Rule A above Rule B so it will run for matching inputs?" confirmation should list changed order. include undo in toast. Liam C: SR announcement pattern: we should announce when the preview changes which rule will run. use aria-live="polite" but debounce to avoid rapid announcements while dragging. example: ```
Preview: Rule A will execute
// update only after 350ms stable ``` Olga P: visual states: winner = gold outline + 96% opacity; shadowed = muted + 60% opacity + dotted overlay. provide a non-color pattern for WCAG. Priya S: validation behavior: when saving, show a non-blocking banner: "Save completed d 2 rules are shadowed. Review" with link to the summary. Dedicated customers can toggle strict mode that blocks save and forces resolution. Noah H: design question: should we show inline inline warnings next to the rule name or keep everything in the summary? hybrid maybe: tiny inline hint icon that opens the summary when clicked. keeps list scannable. Liam C: implementational note for eng: avoid layout shift when toggling the summary. use an overlay or side-drawer that doesn't change list height. animate focus movement so SRs get context. Olga P: small ux nit: tooltip copy when hovering winner in preview: "This rule will run for the simulated input." and when hovering a shadowed rule: "This rule is shadowed by Rule A (higher priority)." keep it short. qa-bot: test reminder set: add e2e for keyboard jump, aria-live debounce, and save-mode toggle. due 1769646400. :spiral_calendar_pad:
